Name: Basketball Motor Observation and Motor Imagery EEG Dataset
Description: 35 healthy participants performed 3 basketball-related motor imagery tasks. Recorded with ANT Neuro device (64 channels, 1000Hz). Includes raw EEG, preprocessed data, and PLV functional connectivity.
EthicsApprovals: This study was conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and approved by the Ethics Committee of Liaoning Normal University (Approval Number: LL2025026).
